measured.method: surface.create_entity{name, position, force} inside pcall on a space-platform surface, one attempt per representative prototype, destroyed immediately; the quoted text is the thrown message
measured.note: nine of these eighteen types CREATE successfully with bare parameters at this pin — their exclusion rests on the reviewed category, not on an engine refusal

entries.reason: render-only direction marker driven by the GUI; the representative fake-selection-box-2x2 creates successfully at this pin, so the exclusion is the reviewed category — an arrow carries no world state a payload could restore
mandatory creation parameter, measured: create_entity threw 'Key "movement" not found in property tree at ROOT' — a flare is a targeting ephemeron that exists only between firing and impact
in-flight ordnance with a mandatory target, measured: create_entity threw 'Can't create artillery-projectile, target not specified.' — its state is a trajectory, not a placement
attached weapon effect with a mandatory endpoint, measured: create_entity threw 'Can't create beam, target/target_position not specified.' — a beam exists only while its source fires
engine-owned delivery vessel created and consumed by the rocket/platform cargo system; it is in transit by definition, so a payload that restored one would place a pod that belongs to no launch
one-shot animation entity that destroys itself when its animation ends; it creates successfully at this pin but cannot outlive the tick range a transfer spans
transient spreading effect with its own lifetime and damage ticking; it creates successfully at this pin, but restoring one would fabricate an ongoing hazard rather than preserve state
render-only GUI overlay, measured: create_entity threw 'highlight-box needs either a bounding_box, source or target' — it is drawn for a player, not owned by the surface
transient weather effect owned by the surface's lightning system; it creates successfully at this pin but is a strike in progress, not a placed object

transient particle emitter; the representative blood-fountain creates successfully at this pin, so unlike the brief's other two mandatory-parameter ephemera this one is excluded on the reviewed category alone
in-flight ordnance with a mandatory target, measured: create_entity threw 'Can't create projectile, target not specified.' — its state is a trajectory, not a placement
engine-owned rocket created by a rocket-silo launch and consumed on arrival; it creates successfully at this pin but belongs to a silo's launch sequence, not to the surface
render-only shadow of a rocket-silo-rocket; it has no state of its own, and its parent is already excluded
transient smoke cloud with its own lifetime and periodic trigger; it creates successfully at this pin but expires on a timer no payload can carry
GUI bubble bound to an entity, measured: create_entity threw 'Need entity target' — it is chrome drawn over an entity, not a thing standing on the surface
status effect attached to a target, measured: create_entity threw 'Can't create sticker, target not specified.' — its identity is the target it modifies
in-flight fluid stream with a mandatory endpoint, measured: create_entity threw 'Can't create fluid stream, target/target_position not specified.' — it exists only between nozzle and impact
